scope: German-language primary-document research on Porsche turbo lineage, racing variants, alloy/process definitions and explicitly scoped aftermarket products. One English MAMBATEK source was discovered through German queries; abstract-only journal leads are bibliography, not technical targets.

records.application: 964 Turbo 3.3, initial version; German Porsche retrospective
records.locator: Section 3. Generation: Porsche 911 Turbo (964)
records.caveat: The historical European rating is not generalized to every market, catalyst version or later 3.6 engine.

records.application: 964 Turbo S 3.3; German Porsche retrospective
records.locator: Final article paragraph describing turbocharged 964 variants
records.caveat: Source distinguishes the 3.3 L Turbo S from the later 3.6 L Turbo. This is not a 993 Turbo S rating.

records.application: 964 Turbo 3.6; Porsche Klassik retrospective technical table
records.locator: Technical data: Porsche 964 Turbo 3.6, Bohrung x Hub
records.caveat: Nominal engine geometry; no piston clearance, cylinder-wall thickness or machining tolerance is defined.

records.application: 964 Turbo 3.6; Porsche Klassik retrospective technical table
records.locator: Technical data: Porsche 964 Turbo 3.6, Verdichtung
records.caveat: Specific to the 964 Turbo 3.6 in this comparison; do not transfer to 993 M64/60 or use as a measured combustion-chamber volume.

records.application: 964 Turbo 3.6; Porsche Klassik retrospective technical table
records.parameter: Published rated power and engine speed
records.locator: Technical data: Porsche 964 Turbo 3.6, Max. Leistung
records.caveat: Published engine rating, not an independently acquired dynamometer map.

records.application: 964 Turbo 3.6; Porsche Klassik retrospective technical table
records.parameter: Torque figure with unresolved overboost label
records.locator: Technical data: Porsche 964 Turbo 3.6, torque row
records.caveat: The table labels this row with overboost but gives no control strategy, duration or pressure. Retain the number as an attributed document statement; the label is not proof of a programmed overboost mode.

records.application: 964 Turbo 3.6; Porsche Klassik retrospective narrative
records.locator: Narrative paragraph introducing the M64 engine after the Paris motor-show debut
records.caveat: A single reported point in a retrospective driving article, not an original engine map or proof of a flat torque plateau.

records.application: 993 Turbo S / factory 450 PS example in Porsche Klassik retrospective
records.parameter: Published rated power and engine speed
records.locator: Technical data: Porsche 993 Turbo S, Max. Leistung
records.caveat: The historical factory 450 PS tune is separate from stock 408 PS and 430 PS versions; no ECU binary or boost map was acquired.

records.application: 993 Turbo S / factory 450 PS example in Porsche Klassik retrospective
records.parameter: Torque figure with unresolved overboost label
records.locator: Porsche Klassik technical table, Porsche 993 Turbo S torque row; heritage page; bilingual PDF p.1
records.caveat: The 2017 table labels the torque row with overboost. Neither the inspected official heritage page nor the one-page datasheet states torque or an overboost function. A contemporaneous model-specific document is required before treating the label as ECU or hardware behaviour.

records.application: 993 Turbo S and 964 Turbo 3.6; German Porsche Klassik technical-table wording
records.locator: Torque-row headings in the 964/993/991 comparison; official heritage PDF p.1
records.caveat: The same overboost heading appears for the air-cooled and modern cars. The inspected documents do not establish an original 993 or 964 programmed overboost mode, its duration or its boost-pressure delta.

records.application: 964 Turbo 3.3, initial catalyst-equipped version; German Porsche retrospective
records.value: Three-way metal catalyst
records.locator: Section 3. Generation: Porsche 911 Turbo (964), first Turbo paragraph
records.caveat: Metal identifies the broad catalyst construction; substrate alloy, washcoat composition, cell density, wall thickness and catalyst dimensions are not disclosed.

records.application: 964 Turbo 3.3, initial catalyst-equipped version; German Porsche retrospective
records.value: Bypass tailpipe with its own catalyst and silencer; bypass gases do not pass through the regular main catalyst
records.locator: Section 3. Generation: Porsche 911 Turbo (964), bypass-tailpipe description
records.caveat: The source attributes avoidance of additional main-catalyst backpressure to this routing. It gives no measured pressure loss, tube thickness, gas-temperature map or catalyst dimensions; do not transfer this layout to the 993 integrated-wastegate system.

records.application: 996 Turbo at introduction; comparison with contemporary naturally aspirated 911
records.locator: Section 5. Generation: Porsche 911 Turbo (996), front cooling-air opening paragraph
records.caveat: Comparison concerns total radiator area. It is not a 50 percent heat-rejection increase, core thickness, measured cooling performance or radiator material specification.

records.application: 996 Turbo original 420 PS version; German Porsche retrospective
records.locator: Section 5. Generation: Porsche 911 Turbo (996), IAA 1999 announcement paragraph
records.caveat: No torque-curve coordinates or associated engine speed are supplied in this source.

records.application: 997.1 Turbo 3.6 with optional Sport Chrono Paket Turbo
records.locator: Section 6. Generation: Porsche 911 Turbo (997), Sport Chrono paragraph
records.caveat: Conditional optional overboost under full acceleration; not continuous-duty operation or a 993 control feature.

records.application: 997.1 Turbo 3.6 with optional Sport Chrono Paket Turbo
records.locator: Section 6. Generation: Porsche 911 Turbo (997), Sport Chrono paragraph
records.caveat: Pressure difference in the midrange, not an absolute manifold pressure or compressor pressure ratio. No baseline operating pressure, inlet losses or compressor map is defined.

records.application: 997.1 Turbo 3.6 with optional Sport Chrono Paket Turbo
records.locator: Section 6. Generation: Porsche 911 Turbo (997), Sport Chrono paragraph
records.caveat: The temporary torque depends on the optional overboost mode and its duration, not a continuous 680 Nm rating or evidence for a 993 map.

records.application: 930 Turbo 3.3, historical factory special-request programme
records.locator: Section 2. Generation Porsche 911 Turbo 3.3 (930), Sonderwunsch programme paragraph
records.caveat: The retrospective describes the increment without identifying an ECU, turbocharger reference, compressor map or exact model-year/market implementation; no specific hardware package is inferred.

records.application: Porsche Classic reproduction aluminium crankcases for unspecified larger-displacement 1990s 911
records.parameter: Published reproduction-material family and CAD recovery
records.value: Aluminium crankcases made from stored blanks; machining data recovered with the Porsche 962 Group C race-engine reproduction project because old production drawings were no longer fully legible
records.locator: Paragraph beginning Seit zwei Jahren gibt es...
records.caveat: This is a manufacturer account of reproduction engineering, not a released CAD drawing or evidence that every 1990s variant uses the same geometry or aluminium grade. M64/60 is not specifically named.

records.application: Porsche Classic replacement crankcases for 1968–1976 911 F/G-series 2.0,2.2,2.4,2.7 L; early-911 comparison only
records.locator: Article introduction and first model-applicability paragraph
records.caveat: Exact magnesium grade and heat treatment are not published. These early naturally aspirated 911 case applications are not a 930 3.0, 993 M64/60, GT2 or GT1 case specification.

records.application: Porsche Classic 2023 early-911 magnesium replacement-crankcase programme
records.value: Sand casting from CAD-based moulds; cores use sand and a resin-containing binder and are destroyed after casting
records.locator: Section Moderne Fertigung unter strengen Qualitätsvorgaben, casting paragraph
records.caveat: Current reproduction route; do not infer that every historical original case used this supplier/process or assign an undisclosed magnesium grade, porosity limit or minimum wall thickness.

records.application: Porsche Classic 2023 early-911 magnesium replacement-crankcase programme

value.tool_count: more than 50 cutting, drilling and milling tools

records.locator: Section Moderne Fertigung unter strengen Qualitätsvorgaben, machining paragraph
records.caveat: Published manufacturing route, not a machining programme, tool diameter, datum definition or production tolerance.

records.application: Porsche Classic 2023 early-911 magnesium replacement-crankcase programme
records.parameter: Example material removal at milled surfaces
records.locator: Section Moderne Fertigung unter strengen Qualitätsvorgaben, machining paragraph
records.caveat: This is approximate machining stock removed at example milled surfaces. It is not finished case-wall thickness, total casting thickness or a permission to remove 3–4 mm from an existing 993 component.

records.application: Porsche Classic 2023 early-911 magnesium replacement-crankcase programme
records.value: Individual inspection using 3D probing and comparison on a 3D coordinate measuring machine; complete inspection covers more than 1300 control dimensions
records.locator: Section Moderne Fertigung unter strengen Qualitätsvorgaben, quality-control paragraph
records.caveat: No individual coordinate, tolerance, inspection report or full drawing is released; the number of checks does not itself qualify an independently reproduced part.

records.application: Porsche Classic 2023 early-911 magnesium replacement-crankcase programme; Carrera RS 2.7 prototype
records.value: A Carrera RS 2.7 prototype engine underwent multi-week dynamometer testing with defined loads and engine speeds, oil-particle checks, full teardown and separate crankcase-half inspection at Weissach
records.locator: Section Moderne Fertigung unter strengen Qualitätsvorgaben, prototype-test paragraph
records.caveat: The source gives no full load spectrum, hours, temperatures, fatigue limits or measurement results. This factory test is not qualification of a 993 Turbo part or of any user-made case.

records.application: Porsche Classic early-911 replacement-crankcase programme
records.value: Reproductions follow the last mature historical series revision; raw-part numbers identify that revision and purchased-part numbers are also marked
records.locator: Paragraph beginning Bei einer solchen Nachfertigung...
records.caveat: Describes Porsche Classic traceability; it does not reveal CAD geometry, exact alloy chemistry, a specific 993 part revision or an equivalence certificate.

records.caveat: Rounded displacement and historical output; no power-peak rpm, boost pressure or alloy grade is specified.

records.caveat: Specific IMSA historical version, not the 993 Turbo biturbo or a rated output for every 964 Turbo 3.6.

records.application: 911 Turbo S Le Mans GT, factory GT racing version, 1993

records.caveat: Restrictor diameter, boost pressure and peak rpm are not given. Distinct from road Turbo S and later 993 GT2.

records.application: 911 GT1, factory competition version, 1996

records.application: 935/78 Moby Dick, 1978

records.application: 935/77, factory racing evolution of 1976 935
records.value: Two smaller turbochargers replaced the large single turbo to respond faster, reduce turbo lag and improve power controllability.
records.locator: Section describing second episode and the 1977 evolution, paragraph beginning In der zweiten Episode
records.caveat: Engineering recollection attributed to Norbert Singer; does not specify compressor maps, rotor dimensions, inertia, speed or a measured transient response time.

records.application: 935 Baby, 1.4 L racing version, 1977, retrospective driving account
records.locator: Section describing third episode, paragraph beginning Die dritte Episode
records.caveat: Driver description attributed to Timo Bernhard; not a dyno measurement, turbo-shaft speed, peak-power rpm or engine rev limit.

records.application: 959 road six-cylinder biturbo engine shown as IAA cutaway
records.locator: Main technical paragraph beginning Der Block des Sechszylinder-Biturbo-Boxers
records.caveat: German factory source explicitly says the block is cast from aluminium alloy. Exact alloy designation, casting method subtype, heat treatment and wall thickness are not given. Does not apply to 993 M64/60.

records.application: 959 Paris-Dakar, restored second-place vehicle from 1986 rally
records.locator: Section Überarbeitung: Die Geschichte des Fahrzeugs authentisch erzählen, opening paragraph
records.caveat: Factory links lower output to fuel quality. Fuel octane, fuel formulation, ignition map, boost pressure and injection calibration are not disclosed.

records.application: 959 Paris-Dakar, rally adaptations, 1980s
records.value: Engine control units were mounted high to reduce damage during river crossings.
records.locator: Section Überarbeitung: Die Geschichte des Fahrzeugs authentisch erzählen, paragraph beginning Für die harte Distanz
records.caveat: Rally packaging adaptation; source supplies no mounting coordinates, protection class, enclosure alloy or circuit specification.

records.application: 959 Paris-Dakar, rally adaptations, 1980s

records.application: 956/962 Group C PDK experiments beginning autumn 1984, mature system from 1987
records.value: Very fast PDK shifts without interrupting drive torque kept turbochargers at high rotational speed.
records.locator: Section Rekordsieger: die Prototypen 956, 962 IMSA und 962 C, paragraph on Motronic, recording and PDK
records.caveat: Qualitative statement only; no turbo-shaft rpm value, shaft inertia or shift time is supplied. Not a 993 manual-transmission operating condition.

records.application: Type 935 and 936 six-cylinder turbo racing-engine development, 1977–1978
records.value: Hans Mezger developed water cooling and the four-valve concept for the type 935 and 936 six-cylinder turbo engines during 1977–1978.
records.locator: Section Karriere und Highlights bei Porsche, 1977–1978 entry
records.caveat: Chronology establishes design lineage, not that all 935/936 versions are water-cooled or share identical heads, materials or component dimensions.

records.application: 956/962 Group C 2.65 L engine development, 1981–1982
records.value: The 2.65 L Group C engine for 956/962 was developed on the basis of type 935/936 engines.
records.locator: Section Karriere und Highlights bei Porsche, 1981–1982 entry
records.caveat: Factory lineage statement; does not prove interchangeability, identical alloys or dimensions, and does not cover every later 962 displacement.
